dsh-permission-rules 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

posts.en:
dsh-permission-rules is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-94e11b5a803913eafd2d.html
